theorem RaftLink.wp_StartNode [package_sem : Assumptions] : StartNode.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.StartNode.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (γ : RaftNames) (md : RNMode) (bud : BudgetNames) (c : Loc) (cv : Config) (lok si : GoInterfaceOk) (σ : StorState)
    (hs : HardStateM) (csm : ConfStateM) (R : IProp GF) (peers : GoSlice) (dq : DFrac) (pv : List Peer) (ps : List w64)
    (ctxs : List (List w8)) (bootLog : List EntryM) (sn : Bool),
    ConfigValid cv →
      cv.Logger' = GoInterface.ok lok →
        cv.Storage' = GoInterface.ok si →
          sint.Z cv.MaxInflightMsgs' < 2 ^ 62 →
            cv.DisableProposalForwarding' = false →
              cv.ReadOnlyOption' = W64 0 →
                cv.DisableConfChangeValidation' = false →
                  cv.MaxCommittedSizePerReady' ≠ W64 0 ∨ cv.MaxSizePerMsg' ≠ W64 0 →
                    cv.AsyncStorageWrites' = false →
                      cv.Applied' = W64 0 →
                        σ.prev = { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 } →
                          σ.ents = [] →
                            uint.Z σ.ss.index' = 0 ∨ σ.ss = σ.prev →
                              σ.pend = [] →
                                HsEmpty hs →
                                  csm.Voters' = [] →
                                    csm.VotersOutgoing' = [] →
                                      csm.Learners' = [] →
                                        csm.LearnersNext' = [] →
                                          csm.AutoLeave' = false →
                                            ps = List.map Peer.ID' pv →
                                              ps ≠ [] →
                                                ps.Nodup →
                                                  ¬W64 0 ∈ ps →
                                                    ↑ps.length ≤ 2 ^ 62 →
                                                      cv.ID' ∈ ps →
                                                        γ.reCfg = listToSet ps →
                                                          γ.reBoot = bootLog →
                                                            BootLogOk ps bootLog →
                                                              σ.fl = W64 0 →
                                                                (sn = true → γ.reNoSnap = false ∧ md = RNMode.static) →
                                                                  ⊢
                                                                    ∀ Φ,
                                                                      isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                                                                          typedPointsto c cv (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                                                                            isLogger lok ∗
                                                                              isStorage (GoInterface.ok si) ∗
                                                                                ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si) σ ∗
                                                                                  (∀ Φ ss',
                                                                                      ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si)
                                                                                          { prev := σ.prev,
                                                                                            ents := σ.ents, ss := ss',
                                                                                            pend := σ.pend, scs := σ.scs,
                                                                                            sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat,
                                                                                            fl := σ.fl } -∗
                                                                                        (∀ hp cs al,
                                                                                            ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si)
                                                                                                { prev := σ.prev,
                                                                                                  ents := σ.ents,
                                                                                                  ss := ss',
                                                                                                  pend := σ.pend,
                                                                                                  scs := σ.scs,
                                                                                                  sal := σ.sal,
                                                                                                  sdat := σ.sdat,
                                                                                                  fl := σ.fl } -∗
                                                                                              R -∗
                                                                                                hsOpt hp hs -∗
                                                                                                  csPts cs DFrac.discard
                                                                                                      csm al -∗
                                                                                                    Φ
                                                                                                      ((intoVal hp,
                                                                                                          intoVal cs),
                                                                                                        intoVal
                                                                                                          GoInterface.nil)) -∗
                                                                                          WP
                                                                                            ((intoVal
                                                                                                (methods si.ty
                                                                                                  go!"InitialState"
                                                                                                  si.v))
                                                                                              (intoVal ()))
                                                                                            {{ Φ }}) ∗
                                                                                    ownSlice peers pv dq ∗
                                                                                      peersCtx pv ctxs ∗
                                                                                        bootMarshal ps ctxs bootLog ∗
                                                                                          bootInit γ md cv.ID'
                                                                                              (listToSet ps) bootLog ∗
                                                                                            isCommitted γ bootLog ∗
                                                                                              inv budgetN
                                                                                                  (budgetInv bud) ∗
                                                                                                termLB bud (W64 1) ∗
                                                                                                  NsCap γ.reNoSnap
                                                                                                      (GoInterface.ok
                                                                                                        si) ∗
                                                                                                    certLink γ
                                                                                                      (GoInterface.ok
                                                                                                        si) -∗
                                                                        (▷
                                                                            ∀ nd,
                                                                              (R ∗
                                                                                  ∃ γn n,
                                                                                    ⌜γn.raft = γ ∧
                                                                                          γn.bud = bud ∧
                                                                                            γn.stor = GoInterface.ok si ∧
                                                                                              γn.mode = md ∧
                                                                                                γn.snapIn = sn ∧
                                                                                                  nd =
                                                                                                    interface.mkOk
                                                                                                      node.ty.PointerType
                                                                                                      (intoVal n)⌝ ∗
                                                                                      ⌜md = RNMode.static ↔
                                                                                            γ.reDyn = none⌝ ∗
                                                                                        isNode γn cv.ID' n ∗
                                                                                          nodeDriver γn cv.ID' n []
                                                                                              hsZero ∗
                                                                                            nodeCfg γn 0
                                                                                                (cfgState (listToSet ps)
                                                                                                  ∅) ∗

                                                                            {{ Φ }}

theorem RaftLink.MemoryStorage.wp_Entries [package_sem : Assumptions] : MemoryStorage.Entries.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.MemoryStorage.Entries.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) (lo hi maxSize : w64) (ec : GoInterface),
    ⊢
      ∀ Φ,
        isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
            "Hms" ∷ ownMemoryStorage ms γs σ ∗
              ⌜uint.Z σ.prev.index' + 1 ≤ uint.Z lo ∧
                    uint.Z lo < uint.Z hi ∧ uint.Z hi ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length + 1⌝ ∗
                ⌜PendFrom σ (uint.Z hi)⌝ ∗ "#Hec" ∷ typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrCompacted) ec DFrac.discard -∗
          (▷
              ∀ s es err,
                ⌜err = ec ∧ uint.Z lo ≤ uint.Z σ.fl⌝ ∗ memStorCut γs (uint.Z lo) ∗ ownMemoryStorage ms γs σ ∨
                    ⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                      entsRO s es ∗
                        ⌜es ≠ [] ∧
                              ↑es.length ≤ uint.Z hi - uint.Z lo ∧
                                (∀ (e : EntryM),
                                    e ∈ es → e ∈ List.take (uint.Z hi - uint.Z σ.prev.index' - 1).toNat σ.ents) ∧
                                  s.cap = s.len ∧
                                    es <+:
                                      List.drop (uint.Z lo - uint.Z σ.prev.index' - 1).toNat
                                        (List.take (uint.Z hi - uint.Z σ.prev.index' - 1).toNat σ.ents)⌝ ∗
                          ownMemoryStorage ms γs σ -∗
                  Φ (intoVal s, intoVal err)) -∗
            WP
              ((((intoVal
                      (methods MemoryStorage.ty.PointerType go!"Entries"
                        (intoVal ms)))
                    (intoVal lo))
                  (intoVal hi))
                (intoVal maxSize))
              {{ Φ }}
